rationale: Hybrid control plane (deterministic, Node) + worker plane (agentic, Python) under a named regulatory regime. `commands.eval` WRITES docs/evidence/eval-summary.json: an eval command that merely exits 0 proves a process ended, not that a threshold was met. `commands.audit` is run by the release gate, where — because complianceProfile is "regulated" — an unrunnable audit BLOCKS instead of being deferred. The authoritative data-boundary record stays docs/compliance-profile.json.
